alpha:one single tag
beta:one beta:two duplicate key becomes an array
Due:2026-01-01 uppercase key is distinct from due
due:2026-01-01 lowercase due is a date tag
h1:1 digits are not allowed in tag keys
a_b:1 underscores are not allowed in tag keys
empty: a key with no value is not a tag
http://example.com is scanned as a tag
due:2025-01-01 tag at the start of a line
note:hello,world! punctuation stays in the value
eq:a=b=c equals signs stay in the value
x task:value tag after a done marker
